title: In Vitro Cytotoxicity Evaluation of Plastoquinone Analogues against Colorectal and Breast Cancers along with In Silico Insights.
authors: Ciftci, Halilibrahim; Sever, Belgin; Bayrak, Nilufer; Yildiz, Mahmut; Yildirim, Hatice; Tateishi, Hiroshi; Otsuka, Masami; Fujita, Mikako; TuYuN, Amac Fatih
one_liner_zh: 该文评估质体醌类似物的抗癌活性，仅通过分子对接初步展示其与DNA结合，缺乏TF-DNA互作机制和AI/物理模拟方法，属于边缘相关。
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) and breast cancer are leading causes of death globally, due to significant challenges in detection and management. The late-stage diagnosis and treatment failures require the discovery of potential anticancer agents to achieve a satisfactory therapeutic effect. We have previously reported a series of plastoquinone analogues to understand their cytotoxic profile. Among these derivatives, three of them (AQ-11, AQ-12, and AQ-15) were selected by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) to evaluate their in vitro antiproliferative activity against a panel of 60 human tumor cell lines. AQ-12 exhibited significant antiproliferative activity against HCT-116 CRC and MCF-7 breast cancer cells at a single dose and further five doses. MTT assay was also performed for AQ-12 at different concentrations against these two cells, implying that AQ-12 exerted notable cytotoxicity toward HCT-116 (IC(50) = 5.11 +/- 2.14 muM) and MCF-7 (IC(50) = 6.06 +/- 3.09 muM) cells in comparison with cisplatin (IC(50) = 23.68 +/- 6.81 muM and 19.67 +/- 5.94 muM, respectively). This compound also augmented apoptosis in HCT-116 (62.30%) and MCF-7 (64.60%) cells comparable to cisplatin (67.30% and 78.80%, respectively). Molecular docking studies showed that AQ-12 bound to DNA, forming hydrogen bonding through the quinone scaffold. In silico pharmacokinetic determinants indicated that AQ-12 demonstrated drug-likeness with a remarkable pharmacokinetic profile for future mechanistic anti-CRC and anti-breast cancer activity studies.
abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）和乳腺癌是全球范围内导致死亡的主要原因，因其在检测和管理方面面临重大挑战。晚期诊断和治疗失败要求发现潜在的抗癌药物以达到满意的治疗效果。我们此前已报道了一系列质体醌类似物，以了解其细胞毒性特征。在这些衍生物中，其中三种（AQ-11、AQ-12和AQ-15）被美国国家癌症研究所（NCI）选中，用于评估其对60种人类肿瘤细胞系的体外抗增殖活性。AQ-12在单剂量及进一步五剂量下，对HCT-116结直肠癌和MCF-7乳腺癌细胞表现出显著的抗增殖活性。此外，还对AQ-12在不同浓度下针对这两种细胞进行了MTT实验，结果表明，与顺铂（IC(50)分别为23.68 ± 6.81 μM和19.67 ± 5.94 μM）相比，AQ-12对HCT-116（IC(50) = 5.11 ± 2.14 μM）和MCF-7（IC(50) = 6.06 ± 3.09 μM）细胞显示出显著的细胞毒性。该化合物还增强了HCT-116（62.30%）和MCF-7（64.60%）细胞的凋亡，与顺铂（分别为67.30%和78.80%）相当。分子对接研究表明，AQ-12与DNA结合，通过醌骨架形成氢键。计算机模拟药代动力学参数表明，AQ-12表现出药物相似性，并具有优异的药代动力学特征，可用于未来机制性抗结直肠癌和抗乳腺癌活性研究。
